name: Restorative Hair Cobditioner Amla, Honey and Mulethi
ingredients_raw: Coconut Endocarp Extract (Cocos nucifera) - 5.0%, Amla Fruit Extract (Emblica officinalis) - 2.5%, Bhringraj Leaf Extract (Eclipta alba)-2.0%, Fenugreek Seed Extract (Trigonella foenum-graecum) - 1.0%, Licorice Root Extract (Glycyrrhiza glabra) - 1.0%, Almond Kernel Oil (Prunus amygdalus dulcis)* 0.55%, Virgin Coconut Endocarp Oil (Cocos nucifera) - 0.5%, Haritaki Fruit Extract (Terminalia chebula) - 0.5%, Nilini Leaf Extract (Indigofera tinctoria linn) - 0.5%, Honey* - 0.5%, Castor Seed Oil (Ricinus Communis) 0.5%, Henna Leaf Extract (Lawsonia inermis) - 0.2%, Beejak Leaf Extract (Pterocarpus marsupium) - 0.2%, Banana Fruit Extract (Musa balbisiana) - 0.2%, Bay Leaf Extract (Cinnamomum tamala) - 0.1%. - Base Contains: Aqua, Glycerin, Betaine (Derived from Sugar Beets), Ceramide NP, Propanediol, Pea Peptide (Pisum sativum), Hydrolyzed Jojoba Esters, Sodium PCA, Sugandhit Dravya, Preservatives, Olive Oil Derived Emulsifiers (Cetearyl Olivate & Sorbitan Olivate), Pro Vitamin B-5, Hydrolyzed Wheat Protein, Mixed Tocopherols (Vitamin E), Cetyl Alcohol, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride (Derived from coconut Oil), Isopropyl Myristate, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Ethylhexyl - glycerin, Sodium Gluconate - QS *Certified Organic
